M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB with 96W Apple charger upgrade is $220 off today

Alongside the new all-time low that went live yesterday on AirPods Pro 3 at nearly 30% off, we are still awaiting the return of Amazon low pricing on many of the M5/M5 Pro MacBook Pro models. B&H, however, has a compelling offer live today on Apple’s most affordable 24GB Pro model at $220 off to undercut Amazon’s best deal.

B&H is now offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity down at $1,699 shipped.

While this machine regularly carries an $1,899 list price, B&H is also throwing in the 96W Apple USB-C Charger upgrade – this would normally run you an extra $20 on the Apple Store, leaving today’s package with a regular price at $1,919:

All-in, with the more powerful charger (this machine comes standard with a 70W charger for the record), you’re looking at $220 off the list price and a deal that nets you the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM at $20 less than the best price Amazon has ever offered it for, and that’s before you factor in the bonus 96W charger.

  • Plus 96W USB-C Power Adapter upgrade worth $20
    • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,699 (Reg. $1,919)

Amazon does carry this same machine, but only with the standard 70W Power Adapter. It is currently selling for $1,749, or $150 off, and has never sold for less than $1,699 there. We could, of course, see this one drop to even less than $1,699 for Prime Day, but considering it has jumped up to $1,749 as of right now, there is an equally good chance it just pops back down to $1,699 later this month (and, again, without the charger upgrade).

Amazon now offering unlocked iPhone 17 Pro units at up to $254 off (Renewed ‘excellent’)

Deals on the latest iPhone 17 Pro are just started to be worthwhile over at Amazon. There are some offers on 17 Pro Max at Woot right now, but Amazon is typically the best place to find deals on the latest Pro models mid-way through the lifecycle and there are some notable renewed discounts live this morning. The iPhone 17 Pro 512GB is up to $184 off and the 1TB is as much as $254 off. Details below.

When it comes to the latest iPhone models, Amazon’s renewed units tend to be the best, most reliable, and most trustworthy options for deals in our experience. You’ll most likely want to stray away from anything that isn’t listed as “refurbished – excellent” or “Renewed Premium” and you’ll want to make sure the unit is shipped and sold direct from/by Amazon, but we are looking looking at a notable chance to save some cash on Apple tech that just does not see new condition deals for unlocked units:

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,115 (Reg. $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,126 (Reg. $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,245 (Reg. $1,499)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,278 (Reg. $1,499)

These are some of the best options we are seeing at the time of writing, but there are other colors/configs on sale. Just be sure to hit the “Other Sellers on Amazon” section on the right hand side of the page to ensure you’re adding a listing that is solid and shipped by Amazon.

And here’s a look at the ongoing Woot deals for 17 Pro Max

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (Reg. $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,500 (Reg. $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,749 (Reg. $1,999)

Score Dad a current-gen iPad for Father’s Day from $299 at Amazon

There are some big-time Apple deals up for grabs this week ahead of Father’s Day, perhaps the most notable of which is AirPods Pro 3 hitting the best price ever at nearly 30% off. But if you’re looking to land pops a new iPad this year without spending a fortune, you can score a current-generation Apple tablet as low as $299 right now.

Amazon is offering Apple’s latest 11-inch iPad (A16) starting from $299 shipped. Some colors are selling for $1 more, but we are talking about deals right at the lowest we have tracked in 2026 here.

  • iPad 11 128GB $299 (Reg. $349)
  • iPad 11 256GB $399 (Reg. $449)
  • iPad 11 256GB $597 (Reg. $649)

Regularly $349, we are yet to see the latest iPad 11 sell for any less than $299 at Amazon this year, but we rarely see it down any lower than this anyway. And even when we do, it’s typically not much more than $20 or $25 less at the most.

The iPad 11 certainly isn’t the most high-tech option in the lineup, and far from the most powerful, but if Dad just needs a handy casual tablet this is a solid price drop on a current-gen Apple iPad, and a particularly sweet gift if you ask me.

Just keep in mind, you can also land Dad the latest AirPods Pro for even less than this and they just dropped to the lowest price to date. But you’ll also want to run through our 2026 feature to get some additional gift ideas if you don’t think the Apple gear will do the trick – the options start from just $26.
